issue.title: Build Account Switcher Panel
issue.body: The mobile app needs to support multiple users sharing a single device — a common pattern in field translation workshops where a phone passes between translators. The account switcher panel is the central UI for this feature: it lists all logged-in accounts on the device and lets users switch between them. All other multi-user tickets depend on this panel existing. ## Functional Requirements ### Panel Layout - Display a bottom sheet or modal panel when the account switcher is triggered. - List all accounts currently logged in on the device, one row per account. - Each row shows the account's first and last initial in a circle and their display name. - Mark the currently active account with a `li:check` icon on the right side of its row. ### Add Account Entry - Show an "Add Account" row at the bottom of the panel with a `li:user-plus` icon. - If three accounts are already logged in, hide the "Add Account" row and show a brief message in its place: "You've reached the 3-account limit." ### Dismissal - Tapping outside the panel or a back gesture dismisses it without changing the active account. > **Note:** Account removal is explicitly out of scope. Do not add a remove or delete affordance to account rows.
